name: RadioGroup
description: Selects one option from a mutually exclusive set.

disabled.description: Disable every option; the group dims once

readOnly.description: The chosen option cannot be changed; item rows stop hovering

required.description: A value must be chosen before the form submits

helperText.description: Helper text shown below the group

invalid.description: The value fails validation: every circle takes the danger edge and errorMessage shows under the group

errorMessage.description: Message shown with a warning icon under the group while invalid; wired to the radiogroup's aria-describedby

variant.description: Chrome. Omit for the inline radio beside its label; 'outline' renders each item as a full-width choice card (surface, hairline, surface radius) whose hairline turns into the selection ring when chosen.

id.description: ID for the element with role=radiogroup (the ref lands there too)

when: Exactly one answer out of two to five
Every option should be visible without opening anything
whenNot: Several answers allowed (use a Checkbox group)
guidelines: Pre-select a sensible default whenever one exists
Order options predictably: alphabetical, by frequency, or by cost
Put the trade-off in each item's helperText
accessibility: The group carries its own label
The selected option reads as checked

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Three options stacked, the first already chosen.
examples.code:
<RadioGroup defaultValue="option1" label="Select an option">
  <RadioGroup.Item value="option1" label="Option 1" />
  <RadioGroup.Item value="option2" label="Option 2" />
  <RadioGroup.Item value="option3" label="Option 3" />
</RadioGroup>

examples.name: With Helper Text
examples.description: Each option carries the trade-off under its label.
examples.code:
<RadioGroup defaultValue="standard" label="Shipping Method">
  <RadioGroup.Item
    value="standard"
    label="Standard"
    helperText="5-7 business days"
  />
  <RadioGroup.Item
    value="express"
    label="Express"
    helperText="2-3 business days"
  />
  <RadioGroup.Item
    value="overnight"
    label="Overnight"
    helperText="Next business day"
  />
</RadioGroup>

examples.name: Horizontal
examples.description: One row — good for short labels like sizes.
examples.code:
<RadioGroup orientation="horizontal" defaultValue="small" label="Size">
  <RadioGroup.Item value="small" label="S" />
  <RadioGroup.Item value="medium" label="M" />
  <RadioGroup.Item value="large" label="L" />
  <RadioGroup.Item value="xlarge" label="XL" />
</RadioGroup>

examples.name: With Group Helper Text
examples.description: One note under the whole group instead of per option.
examples.code:
<RadioGroup defaultValue="standard" label="Plan" helperText="You can change your plan at any time">
  <RadioGroup.Item value="free" label="Free" />
  <RadioGroup.Item value="standard" label="Standard" />
  <RadioGroup.Item value="pro" label="Pro" />
</RadioGroup>

examples.name: With Error
examples.description: invalid draws the danger edge on every circle; errorMessage prints the reason with an icon.
examples.code:
<RadioGroup
  label="Required selection"
  invalid
  errorMessage="Choose an option to continue."
>
  <RadioGroup.Item value="a" label="Option A" />
  <RadioGroup.Item value="b" label="Option B" />
</RadioGroup>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: The choice stays visible but nothing can change it.
examples.code:
<RadioGroup disabled defaultValue="locked" label="Locked selection">
  <RadioGroup.Item value="locked" label="This is locked" />
  <RadioGroup.Item value="other" label="Cannot select" />
</RadioGroup>

relations.note: Use Select for many options or limited space
Use Switch for binary on/off choices

propsSummary: variant: outline - each item a full-width choice card; omit for the inline control
helperText: string - helper text below the group
invalid: boolean - danger edge on every circle; pair with errorMessage
errorMessage: node - message with an icon under the group while invalid
disabled: boolean - disable all options (dims once)
readOnly: boolean - lock the chosen option
RadioGroup.Item: value, label, helperText, disabled, trailing (a short value at the end of the row on the label's line; pairs with variant=outline for plan pickers)
